question: India's first Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Technological Park was launched in ______ in March 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is Bengaluru.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **At the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) in Bengaluru, an Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Technology Park (ARTPARK) with seed funding of Rs 230 crore was inaugurated in March 2022.**
 
• The **Karnataka government** would be responsible for the remaining Rs 230 crore</s
